description: Developing this portfolio was my first time working on a web-app project. The process of learning the technologies that went into this project was highly enjoyable, leaving me feeling like the domain of my potential as a developer has expanded ten fold. I look forward to utilizing React and related technologies to make more interesting applications in the future

The focus of this project was to get comfortable with API's. I chose the Spotify API because I am listening to music whenever it is appropriate to do so, and someones even when it's not. To complete this project I learnt about standard API call practices and presenting the data from a JSON in a structured format

MyShell is a custom-built, interactive command-line interpreter (shell) for Linux. Developed from scratch in C, this project demonstrates a deep understanding of operating systems concepts, including process control, file descriptor manipulation, and memory management. Developed for MRU's COMP 3659 (Operating Systems) class.

This Single-Page Application (SPA) is a responsive e-commerce storefront for COMP 3612, built with vanilla JavaScript and Tailwind CSS. It features dynamic routing, product filtering, and a persistent shopping cart using LocalStorage, all without external JS frameworks. Data is efficiently fetched from a REST API and cached locally. The minimalist design uses semantic HTML5 and templates for clean, modular code.

A lightweight, multi-threaded HTTP web server in C, implementing a thread pool architecture with synchronization (mutexes/condition variables) to handle concurrent client connections. Features include robust HTTP request parsing, static file serving with MIME type detection, standard error handling (200/400/404/500), and path traversal security, demonstrating core OS networking and concurrency concepts.
